title: Hold a tobacco retailer's or wholesaler's licence
what: Sell tobacco products by retail only under a retailer's licence, and by wholesale only under a wholesaler's licence.

sources.title: Tobacco Products Control Act 2006 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not sell a tobacco product by way of retail sale except under the authority of a retailer's licence
